name: Authentik
description: Authentik is an identity provider for single sign-on (SSO) authorization and authentication, with support for SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, and more. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Authentik as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Identity provider for SSO and authentication. Deploy Authentik with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
configText: The exact Authentik Docker Compose and template configuration this template deploys.
